summary: Pending load request of an instancing batch (instanced scenery meshes) in the stream loader: ls::StreamSystemLoadHelper::UpdateLoadRequests<InstancingBatchRegisteredComponent, InstancingBatchLoadComponent, InstancingBatchComponent, ...> (macOS names) keeps it; ls::InstancingSystem (FinishFolderLoad, ProcessBatchModifyRequests, StartGroupVisualLoads, Update) writes it, ProcessBatchModifications reads it. Same aio::Priority encoding as ls::TerrainLoadComponent / ls::PhysicsLoadComponent (SE Physics.h: aio::Priority Priority) but without the callback. Seen alive on idle levels.
